geometry_edits.rationale: Replace the current bent_bar with a split_wing macro so the mass can open a clear void while preserving one dominant composed figure.
Use the long axis to organize two wings around a usable central/public threshold.
Open a meaningful gap for court-like public space rather than a shallow notch.
Maintain continuity across the split so the volume still reads as one projective mass.
Strengthen the ground edge and make the access response legible at street level.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the dominant bent-bar with a split-wing strategy to create a clearer ground threshold and a legible public void instead of a sealed compact block.
Align the split to the long axis so the mass can open coherently toward the frontage and organize a courtyard/entry seam.
Keep a bridged connection so the dominant gesture remains one mass, not fragmented pieces.
Add a grounded spine to strengthen the street threshold and make the lower level read as active support.

rationale: The candidate reads as a single compact mass in all four views, so it has some coherence and repair integrity, but it does not yet satisfy the neighborhood-living brief. The dominant form is basically a blocky bent-bar/courtyard seed with only a modest top articulation; the visible void is weak and does not register as a public court, entry seam, or active ground threshold. Across views the mass remains mostly sealed at the base and the road frontage edge is not clearly opened in the required access direction, so the public-threshold logic is underdeveloped. The silhouette is not incoherent, but it is still close to a generic extrusion with slight topping variation rather than a clearly programmed street building. Because the form does not convincingly express an active ground edge plus one clear public void/terrace, program_fit_hard_pass fails.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: The reference is more pavilion-like and materially different; use only the massing principle, not the façade language.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Low-rise neighborhood-commercial mass with a calm primary volume and a small attached vertical/service element; the ground response is legible and not over-complicated.

warnings: The verified access edge is not given a legible open response in the massing.
The visible court/void figure is too small to count as meaningful public space.
Do not over-reward the stepped roof; it is not yet a program-bearing section move.
